## Web Playground Integration
Dedicated workflow for the **Next.js Chatbot Playground** and **Web Widget**.

### Webhook Endpoint
`POST /webhook/driplare-web-playground`

### Expected Payload from Next.js `/api/playground/chat`
```json
{
  "chatbotId": "string",
  "sessionId": "string",
  "userMessage": "string",
  "platform": "WEB",
  "mediaType": "text" | "image" | "audio",
  "mediaUrl": "string | null"
}
```

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ error: 'Invalid request: chatbotId and sessionId are required.', status: 400 }) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO "chatbot"."ChatSession" ("id", "chatbotId", "sessionId", "platform", "guestName", "profilePhoto", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (
  'cs_' || md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text),
  '{{ $('Validate & Normalize Payload').item.json.chatbotId }}',
  '{{ $('Validate & Normalize Payload').item.json.sessionId }}',
  'WEB',
  'Web User',
  NULL,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT ("chatbotId", "sessionId")
DO UPDATE SET
  "guestName" = EXCLUDED."guestName",
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
RETURNING "sessionId", "platform", "guestName", "createdAt", "updatedAt";
